messages:
elena: quick thought  we should make a compact one	pager that combines security controls, SLA highlights, and a deploy
mode decision strip. use as webinar follow
up + gated download.
michael: agree. keep it scannable: top 1-line value, 3 micro sections (Security, SLA & Reliability, Deploy Tradeoffs), and a single CTA that maps to a routed form.
devin: security bullets: customer
kms support, optional HSM, audit logs + SIEM hooks, data residency controls. prefacing line: "legal review required for compliance claims."
ravi: SLA bullets: targeted SLOs per mode (hosted/dedicated/private), 95th pct latency band for Dedicated, and automatic fallback behavior. include one-line "When to pick" guidance.
elena: bench callout (provisional): "Conservative estimate: 95th pct latency ~90-120ms on Dedicated (8k ctx, KV warm). Estimated ~$0.45/1k tokens for typical assistant workload." label "engineering provisional".
michael: marketing ops: ensure downloads create an inbound lead with tag `enterprise_solution_compact` and capture fields: account_size, compliance_needs, requested_feature, security_priority, requested_trial. route logic below.
```
if lead.tag == "enterprise_solution_compact":
  if lead.account_size >= 1000000:
    route -> enterprise_AE_queue
  elif lead.compliance == true:
    route -> solutions_engineering_queue
  else:
    route -> growth_AE_pool
  # always set lead.source = "webinar_followup" when from download
```
devin: add a small sales play box in the one
page: 3 qualifying q's (data residency, peak QPS, audit timeline) + 2 rebuttals. AEs get a 30s script.
ravi: include a tiny routing fallback note for ops: if enterprise_AE_queue overloaded, escalate to SE queue and set priority=high.
michael: webinar CTA: "Watch: Deploy Modes for Regulated Orgs (30m)" + link to recording. followup email should attach the PDF and include 3 micro-bench charts.
elena: legal + infra signoff required before publish. timeline: draft copy by Tue EOD, final PDF by next Wed, ops to map SFDC tags by Fri.
salesbot: doc created: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1unique-enterprise-compact-draft (marketing,sales) :white_check_mark:
devin: tiny ask: include a one-line ROI for finance buyers emphasizing cost predictability and lower ops burden vs self-hosting. keep conservative language.
michael: i'll own content + bench signoff. ravi will own routing + SFDC. elena: will assemble design and post in #marketing when ready.
elena: thanks team  i'll drop first draft later today and tag legal. :rocket:
